title: A parametrized $\diamondsuit$ for the Laver property and nontrivial automorphisms of $\mathcal P(ω)/\mathrm{Fin}$
summary: We introduce a new parametrized diamond principle denoted $\diamondsuit(\mathsf{LP})$. This principle is akin to the parametrized diamonds of Moore, Hrušák, and Džamonja, each of which corresponds to some cardinal invariant of the continuum, and gives a $\diamondsuit$-like guessing principle implying the corresponding invariant is $\aleph_1$. Our principle $\diamondsuit(\mathsf{LP})$ is a $\diamondsuit$-like guessing principle implying the Laver property holds over a given inner model, such as the ground model in a forcing extension.
